welcome_text: Welcome to Our School Welcome to U-GRO Learning Centre of Lititz! A part of the Lititz community since 2008, our modern center is settled on a two-acre campus in Brighton just off of Fruitville Pike, making it convenient to serve our surrounding community and commuters. We offer several different early education programs taught by our talented team of teachers, including Infant Care, Toddler, Preschool, and School-Age options. We're committed to keeping you connected throughout the day while your child is in our care. Get access to live streaming video of your child's classroom, plus other real-time updates, with our exclusive mobile app for families, SproutAbout. We invite you to schedule a tour today of our U-GRO Learning Centre here in Lititz, PA!

Meet Our Staff Emily Bokankowitz, Director Education : Bachelor's Degree in Early Childhood Education; Master's Degree in Education with a Focus in Literacy As a U-GRO team member since 2015, I have served as a preschool teacher and assistant director before becoming a center director in 2020. I love seeing the pure joy on every child's face as they enter the building and watching our team of teachers expand each child's knowledge, every day.
